_readme: Every spoken line in Bus Buddies Road Trip. Edit a line's text here, then run `node scripts/bus-buddies/generate-voices.mjs` to rebuild only the lines that changed. `chapter` decides which audio pack the line is loaded with (0 = shared, loaded with every chapter). Keep lines short: under 10 words where possible.

turtle.name: Tuck the Turtle
turtle.style: Soft and slow, a little shy

lines.text: Press the green GO button!
Tap the arrows to tell Bina where to drive.
Let's fix it together. Try again!
Want a hint? Follow the sparkly arrow.
I can add the next block for you.
There! Now you try the rest.
Great job! You made a program!
You earned a sticker for your book!
Hmm, we're not there yet. More road!
Oops! Buses can't drive on grass!
Oops! That's a cow field! Moo!
Whoa! Not the flower garden!
Uh oh! The road ends here!
Wait! We drove past a friend!
Beep beep! We did it!
Honk honk! Hello!
Good morning! I'm Captain Codey.
And I'm Bina the Bus! Beep beep!
Our friends are waiting at their bus stops.
You tell me where to go!
Drive forward two times to reach Tuck.
Dot is around the corner. Turn to find her!
Olive is sleepy. Honk to wake her up!
Pick up everyone, then drive to school.
Um... hi. Can I ride too?
Thank you... for waiting for me.
Quack! Hee hee! Room for me?
Wheee! Faster, Bina! Hee hee!
Zzz... five more minutes...
Oh! Is it morning already? Yawn.
All my buddies are on board!
You put the steps in order. That's coding!
